verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so a user can download an API spec directly. A community comment separately refers to calling CodeRabbit's API. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, evidence of which endpoints it covers and how complete it is, independent corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
